hero.title: About
hero.description: A socio-cultural association dedicated to supporting and guiding immigrants in Vitoria-Gasteiz.

introduction.title: Building bridges toward a more inclusive society
introduction.description: We are a socio-cultural association committed to accompanying and supporting immigrants in Vitoria-Gasteiz and the Historical Territory of Álava.
introduction.description2: Our work focuses on promoting social inclusion, intercultural coexistence, and equal rights and opportunities.
introduction.vision: A society where everyone can participate, thrive, and feel a sense of belonging.

missionValues.title: Mission & Values
missionValues.description: The principles guiding our daily work and our relationship with people and the community.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To promote social inclusion, intercultural coexistence, and comprehensive support for immigrants in Vitoria-Gasteiz and Álava, ensuring equal rights and opportunities.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: We base our work on solidarity, diversity, empathy, and transparency. We work to create safe spaces and inclusive communities free from discrimination.

solidarity.title: Solidarity
solidarity.description: Support and guidance built on closeness and mutual respect.

diversity.title: Diversity
diversity.description: We value different cultures, experiences, and perspectives.

empathy.title: Empathy
empathy.description: We listen and guide while remaining attentive to each person's needs.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: We act with responsibility, clarity, and dedication.

commitment.title: Commitment to Vitoria-Gasteiz
commitment.description: Our work aims to provide support, participation, and integration spaces for both immigrants and the wider public.
